name: Georgia
notes: Depth: seed pass R001 (2026-11-13), in English, Georgian and Russian. Georgia has no tax on net wealth and no party, union or economist was found calling for one: the live debates are the progressive income tax (blocked by article 94 of the constitution, which needs a referendum for tax rises), the property tax and the 2025 offshore-assets tax relief, all out of definition. Zero supporters, six exclusions, five open leads. Geography: country root, 10 regions (Adjara is an autonomous republic), Tbilisi, 70 municipalities and self-governing cities, plus the Abkhazia and South Ossetia (Provisional Administration) areas outside government control; OCHA COD-AB with OCHA P-codes, CC BY-IGO. Seats tab: the Parliament's 150 seats by list from the CEC count of the 26 October 2024 election (Interpressnews, 27 Oct 2024); the opposition lists boycotted or lost their mandates, so no member is listed. No poll on a wealth tax was found.
